info.title: Wavelet API
info.description:
Music streaming / library API behind wavelet (Next.js on Vercel).

## Response envelope
Every `/api/v1/*` JSON route returns `{ "success": true, "data": … }` or `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message" } }`.
Branch on `error.code`, not on the message. `/api/auth/*` (better-auth) does NOT use this envelope.

## Authentication
better-auth session (Google only), accepted two ways:
- **Bearer (native / Flutter)**: sign in with `POST /api/auth/sign-in/social` + Google `idToken`, read the `set-auth-token` response header, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request — including the audio player's requests. Sessions last 30 days.
- **Cookie (web)**: `__Secure-better-auth.session_token` (plus `__Secure-better-auth.session_data`, a 5-min signed cache).
Many routes also need a connected Deezer account (`NO_DEEZER_ARL` → call `/api/v1/auth/login-arl`).

## Ids
`trackId`, `deezerAlbumId`, `deezerArtistId` are Deezer ids (as strings). `albumId` in `/library/albums/{albumId}` and playlist ids are internal cuids.

get.description: Range supported when served from cache (206); live fallback has `Accept-Ranges: none`. Each call increments the play counter.

get.summary: Step 1 — presigned direct URL if the track is cached
get.description:
Recommended playback flow:
1. `GET /stream-url/{id}` → if `url` is set, play it directly (CDN, Range-capable, ~15 min validity).
2. Otherwise play `GET /stream-progressive/{id}` (live from Deezer, persisted to Blob in the background).
`/stream/{id}` is the same-origin proxy for cached files.
Cache miss / storage down → 302 to `/api/v1/stream-progressive/{trackId}`. The audio player must follow redirects and keep sending the session cookie.

get.summary: Live stream from Deezer (decrypted on the fly, persisted in background)
get.description: No Range support (`Accept-Ranges: none`) — seeking beyond the buffer requires restarting the stream. Already cached → 302 to `/api/v1/stream/{trackId}`.

bearerAuth.description: Session token from the `set-auth-token` header returned by `/api/auth/sign-in/social`.

NoDeezerArl.description: `NO_DEEZER_ARL` — user has no Deezer account connected (send them to login-arl)

NoDeezer.description: `NO_DEEZER` — no user nor service Deezer session available

DeezerUser.description: Deezer may send extra keys; they are ignored.

currentChild.description: Index of the selected account in `childs`

Settings.description: Wavelet engine settings (bitrate, path templates, tagging, …). Key example: `maxBitrate` (1 = MP3 128, 3 = MP3 320, 9 = FLAC). Shape mirrors `src/lib/wavelet/types/Settings.ts`.

settings.description: Same shape as SettingsBundle, or `{}` if the app is not initialized.

DeezerPage.description: Raw Deezer GW page payload (`gw.get_page`). Contains `sections[]` with `items[]`.

items.description: Deezer public API object (track / album / artist / playlist)

DeezerTracklist.description: Raw Deezer GW payload. `type=album` → album page + `tracks[]`; `type=playlist` → playlist page + `tracks[]`; `type=artist` → artist page + `topTracks[]` + `discography`. GW objects use uppercase keys (SNG_ID, ALB_ID, ART_ID, …).

DeezerSearchMain.description: Merged GW search payload with `TRACK`, `ALBUM`, `ARTIST`, `PLAYLIST`, `TOP_RESULT`, `ORDER`, … Each bucket is `{ data: [], count }`. Items are GW objects (uppercase keys) possibly mixed with public-API objects (lowercase keys) appended for extra coverage.

tracks.description: Subset of trackIds that are saved

albums.description: Subset of albumIds that are saved

covers.description: Cover URLs of the first 4 tracks

truncated.description: true when the playlist had more than 500 tracks

preCacheSaved.description: Warm the Blob cache when saving a track/album

SkipResult.description: Either `{ kept: true, reason }` or `{ evicted: true }`.

expiresIn.description: Hours until expiry. Omit for a permanent link.

url.description: Presigned Vercel Blob URL, valid ~15 min. null → use /stream-progressive.

callbackURL.description: Where to land after the OAuth redirect flow (web flow only)

token.description: Google ID token from the native Google Sign-In SDK

idToken.description: Native mobile flow: no browser redirect, session cookie set directly on the response.

SocialSignInResult.description: better-auth may send extra keys; they are ignored.
